The '''NA LCS 2016 Summer''' second split of 2016 of the [[North American League of Legends Championship Series]] (NA LCS), held from June 3 to August 28, 2016. The regular season took place in Los Angeles and Toronto, with the playoffs concluding offline at the Air Canada Centre. Ten teams competed, including returning Spring Split teams and promoted squads from the [[LCS/North_America/2016/Summer/Promotion|2016 Summer Promotion series]], battling for a $100,000 prize pool and qualification to the [[World Championship/2016|2016 World Championship]]. The split consisted of a Double Round Robin Group Stage (all matches Best-of-Three) followed by Single Elimination Playoffs (all matches Best-of-Five). Top teams earned points for seeding and qualification for both the playoffs and the World Championship. This season also saw major roster changes, including [[Phoenix1]] acquiring [[Team Impulse]]’s LCS spot and [[Team EnVyUs]] acquiring [[Renegades]]’ spot, reshaping the North American competitive scene for the latter half of 2016.
